name: Sanity's Edge
summary: Sanity's Edge is the dreamworld of Warlock Vanton. It is a trial and can be entered via Vanton's wizard tower on the Telvanni Peninsula, southwest of Alavelis. You will receive a Crystallized Memory with your other rewards for completing this trial on Hard Mode.

achievements.name: Sane and Clearheaded
achievements.description: Complete all the listed achievements for Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Sanity's Edge Vanquisher
achievements.description: Defeat Exarchanic Yaseyla, Archwizard Twelvane, and Ansuul the Tormentor in Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Sanity's Edge Conqueror
achievements.description: Defeat Exarchanic Yaseyla, Archwizard Twelvane, and Ansuul the Tormentor in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Tenacious Dreamer
achievements.description: Defeat Exarchanic Yaseyla, Archwizard Twelvane, and Ansuul the Tormentor after raising the challenge banner in Veteran Sanity's Edge in one run.

achievements.name: Sanity's Edge Sprinter
achievements.description: Defeat all enemies in addition to Exarchanic Yaseyla, Archwizard Twelvane, and Ansuul the Tormentor in Veteran Sanity's Edge within 30 minutes. Your time begins when you enter Vanton's Nightmare.

achievements.name: Lucid Dreaming
achievements.description: Defeat all enemies in addition to Exarchanic Yaseyla, Archwizard Twelvane, and Ansuul the Tormentor without suffering a group member death in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Master of the Mind
achievements.description: Defeat Exarchanic Yaseyla, Archwizard Twelvane, and Ansuul the Tormentor along with all their hostile followers after raising the challenge banner for each of them, without suffering a group member death, within 30 minutes of entering Vanton's Nightmare in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Terror Slayer
achievements.description: Defeat 125 Disruptors, Voidmasters, Summoners, Butchers, and Enforcers in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Paranoxia Slayer
achievements.description: Defeat 50 Paranoxia in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Positive Visualization
achievements.description: 8 unique players must use Vanton's Clarity to kill Horrors while fighting Exarchanic Yaseyla in Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Astral Cycle
achievements.description: As a group, never fail to input the correct crystal control sequence during the encounter with Archwizard Twelvane in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Clinical Mortality
achievements.description: Once the Chimera comes to life, it never returns to its statue form during the encounter with Archwizard Twelvane in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Voice of Clarity
achievements.description: Enter Vanton's Torment 7 times during the encounter with Ansuul the Tormentor in Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Fearless Sanity
achievements.description: Complete each Torment with fewer than 4 players during the encounter with Ansuul the Tormentor in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Group Therapy
achievements.description: Have 11 players reach the end on a single maze run while fighting Ansuul the Tormentor in Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Mage Protector
achievements.description: Defeat Exarchanic Yaseyla after raising the challenge banner in Veteran Sanity's Edge.

achievements.name: Dream Destroyer
achievements.description: Defeat Archwizard Twelvane after raising the challenge banner in Veteran Sanity's Edge.
